component.name: VoxBridge Compose
component.summary: Local speech recognition and text refinement

description.p: VoxBridge Compose is a local-first speech workspace for Windows and Linux. Start recording, continue speaking while working in another window, then review both the raw transcript and refined text.
Speech recognition runs through the local VoxBridge runtime. Text refinement can use an embedded local model or a user-configured Ollama service.
Private mode prevents new history, recording files, and diagnostic session logs from being retained.
